name: Yuragi Spa
description: Yuragi Spa — a booking-led theme for a day spa with a short list of treatments and quiet rooms. A white and pale grey ground, a full-bleed film-grain photograph with three pairs of contrast words and (01) (02) (03) counters, a light information bar with a clay booking cell, lenticular-bracket labels with italic sublines, a looped treatment-name row, a sticky treatment list and an ultra-wide letterbox band with a white caption card. EB Garamond for headings, Outfit for reading. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours.
